title: SF1261 (2017-2018 Regular): Firearm transfers criminal background checks requirement

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/90/2017/0/SF/1261/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Version read: introduced (as filed). No passage vote recorded. Section 1 sets a first conviction as a gross misdemeanor; a second or later conviction is a felony (up to two years or $5,000). Section 2 renumbers the exclusions list in 624.7132, subd. 12 and strikes old numbering; Section 4 repeals 609.66, subd. 1f and 624.7132, subd. 14.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 609.66, subd. 1i): (1) for a first conviction, is guilty of a gross misdemeanor; and
Section 3 (Minn. Stat. 624.7134, subd. 2): (1) each transfer of a firearm occurring in whole or in part in the state shall be preceded by a background check on the transferee; and (2) no transferor shall transfer a firearm, and no transferee shall receive a firearm, unless the transferee first complies with this section.
Section 3 (Minn. Stat. 624.7134, subd. 3): Where both parties to a prospective firearm transfer are unlicensed persons, the transferor and transferee shall appear jointly before a federally licensed firearms dealer with the firearm and request that the federally licensed firearms dealer conduct a background check on the transferee and facilitate the transfer.
Section 3 (Minn. Stat. 624.7134, subd. 5): If the transferee is prohibited by federal law from purchasing or possessing the firearm, or not entitled under state law to possess the firearm, neither the federally licensed firearms dealer nor the transferor shall transfer the firearm to the transferee.
Section 3 (Minn. Stat. 624.7134, subd. 8): A federally licensed firearms dealer may charge a reasonable fee for conducting a background check and facilitating a transfer between the transferor and transferee pursuant to this section.
